 LJ Cryer scores 13 points in loss to Houston 
 by Garrett Ball | Warriors Correspondent | Thu, Nov 12th 2026, 11:43am EST 
 LJ Cryer scored 13 points (4-9 FG, 3-8 3P, 2-2 FT) with a rebound and an assist in the Warriors’ 115-108 loss to the Rockets. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Cryer now has back to back game with 10 or more points, and has seen his playing time rise dramatically. If the trend continues he could find himself usable as a low end start for fantasy. However, his floor is basement level, as he has often been held to just a couple minutes of play, so don’t go looking to add him yet.
